title: Aftercare for Good Pets (Xtra Aftertalk)
description: For my pets to slowly come back to things after they've had an intense scene with me... Just imagine sitting down by my feet, head pressed back, against my thighs, right in the middle. So that, if I wanted, I could push them together a little bit. A gentle squeeze; enough to make you feel being taken care of, and protected. Just like my little puppy. Nothing else matters right now, except finding peace, relaxation, and our own quiet happiness here together. UpdateI got an actual real puppy!! Isn't he just the cutest little thing you've ever seen?
author: Mistress Shibby
